interlaced.looks_like: comb teeth on every moving edge

telecine.looks_like: comb teeth on two frames of every five

blended.looks_like: ghosted double images where two drawings or fields are mixed

partly_interlaced.looks_like: comb teeth in some stretches only (titles, credits, an inserted scene)

chroma_shift.looks_like: colour sitting beside the lines instead of inside them

padded_repeats.looks_like: one picture shown twice at regular intervals; motion judders

black_borders.looks_like: black bars at the edges that are not picture

block_edges.looks_like: a grid of square blocks in flat colours and around lines

noise.looks_like: fine dancing speckle over the whole picture, different on every frame

head_switching.looks_like: a band of torn lines at the bottom of a tape capture

halos.looks_like: a bright rim running along dark lines

rainbows.looks_like: shimmering colour bands on fine black-and-white detail (composite video)

dot_crawl.looks_like: a crawling checkerboard along colour edges (composite video)

stair_steps.looks_like: jagged steps on diagonal lines from an earlier bad resize or deinterlace

banding.looks_like: visible steps in smooth gradients (skies, fades)

chroma_noise.looks_like: blotchy colour crawling in flat areas while the lines stay sharp (tape)

spots.looks_like: dust, dirt or scratches that appear on single frames (film), dropouts (tape)

residual_combing.looks_like: faint leftover teeth after an earlier deinterlace

brightness_flicker.looks_like: the whole picture pulsing lighter and darker

jitter.looks_like: the whole picture trembling or weaving (film gate, tape)

top_flagging.looks_like: the top of the picture bending sideways (tape)
top_flagging.why: a timing error: capture the tape again through a time-base corrector

clipped_highlights.looks_like: bright areas burnt to plain white
clipped_highlights.why: the detail is not in the file
